Generated Narrative: CodeSystem em-breathing-status

This case-sensitive code system https://nshr-uat.sha.go.ke/fhir/CodeSystem/em-breathing-status defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
normal NormalBreathing appears normal.
labored LaboredBreathing appears difficult or labored.
gasping GaspingThe patient appears to be gasping or breathing agonal breaths.
absent AbsentNo breathing is apparent.
unknown UnknownBreathing status could not be established.
